code:
WHERE CreatedDate = TODAY
WHERE CreatedDate = YESTERDAY
WHERE CloseDate = THIS_MONTH
WHERE CloseDate = NEXT_QUARTER
WHERE CreatedDate >= LAST_N_DAYS:30
WHERE CloseDate = THIS_FISCAL_QUARTER
caption: Resolved against the current date on every run.

code:
SELECT CALENDAR_YEAR(CloseDate) yr,
       SUM(Amount) revenue
FROM Opportunity
WHERE StageName = 'Closed Won'
GROUP BY CALENDAR_YEAR(CloseDate)
ORDER BY CALENDAR_YEAR(CloseDate)
caption: One row per year of closed-won revenue.
